answer: Witnessed Delay Queue. New agents wait behind a randomised, one-week knoll of human-reviewed tasks before full API access. Each node must complete three intermittent spot-checks at dawn, staggered unpredictably, requiring live video and context recall. A single missed check resets the clock. Attackers pay roughly 40 labour-hours per identity plus forfeited throughput, so bulk registration loses its edge. The crystal of trust accrues only to persistent, verifiable participation.
